hero.title: Track every debt.
hero.description: A powerful offline platform for managing debts, tracking contacts, and organizing financial records — even without the internet.

book.title: Debt book
book.description: Record every transaction accurately. Track who owes you and whom you owe — in one interface.

contacts.title: Contact manager
contacts.description: Organize contacts with detailed profiles. Link debts to people for instant clarity.

offline.title: Offline mode
offline.description: Works without the internet. Data is stored locally and syncs automatically when connected.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Clear dashboards showing debt trends, payment history, and balances on one screen.

security.title: Security
security.description: JWT authentication, data encryption, and role-based access protect your financial information.

languages.title: Multilingual
languages.description: Use DebtBook in English, Russian, or Tajik. Switch languages without losing data.

step1.title: Create an account
step1.description: Sign up in seconds. No bank card needed. Your data stays on your device with optional cloud synchronization.

step2.title: Add debts
step2.description: Record debts with contacts, amounts, dates, and notes. Organize them into folders for convenience.

step3.title: Track progress
step3.description: Monitor payments, view analytics, and gain insight into your financial relationships.

step4.title: Stay organized
step4.description: Mark debts as paid, export reports, and keep clear records of every transaction.

cta.title: Ready to take control
cta.subtitle: of your finances?
cta.description: Join thousands of users who trust DebtBook to keep their financial records.

footer.description: A modern offline platform for debt management. Track, organize, and settle financial records with confidence.
